description.en: Sets the AI "purpose" marker shown on the pitch during a scripted match sequence — a highlighted target/arrow used to direct the player's attention (e.g. towards a teammate to pass to), with an optional world-space position offset.
Numeric purpose/marker type; 0 clears the current marker.
Optional target index the marker points at (e.g. -1 for none).
Optional extra parameter, meaning not confirmed.
Optional X offset applied to the marker's position.
Optional Z offset applied to the marker's position.
True once the purpose marker has been updated; null if no arguments were given.
